# gps

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/soutomas/gps/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/soutomas/gps/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->


The goal of gps is to provide some utility functions for interfacing with GPS. 

## Installation

You can install the development version of gps from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("soutomas/gps")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to start using gps:

```{r example}
library(gps)

# Add to source control 
# loc = "location"
# gps_sc("test.txt",loc)

```
